Yes, if you stay longer than 3 months out of the country without a valid excuse like a significant family emergency, you will almost certainly run into trouble with the visa. That doesn't mean they will terminate your case, but they might give you shorter visa durations (6 months) and extend your waiting period for permanent status.
The 3 months are not set in stone either, so some branches will give you trouble even if you stay abroad less than that.
